listDescription: Service Desk ticket tracking list for managing IT and departmental support requests.

fields.Description: Auto-generated ticket identifier (e.g., INC-0001). Populated by Power Automate.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Text" DisplayName="Ticket ID" Required="FALSE" EnforceUniqueValues="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" MaxLength="20" ID="{b1e2c3d4-5f6a-7b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e}" StaticName="TicketID" Name="TicketID" Description="Auto-generated ticket identifier (e.g., INC-0001). Populated by Power Automate." />

fields.Description: Brief summary of the issue or request.
Detailed description of the issue, including steps to reproduce if applicable.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Note" DisplayName="Description" Required="FALSE" RichText="TRUE" RichTextMode="FullHtml" NumLines="10" AppendOnly="FALSE" ID="{a2b3c4d5-6e7f-8a9b-0c1d-2e3f4a5b6c7d}" StaticName="Description" Name="Description" Description="Detailed description of the issue, including steps to reproduce if applicable." />

<Field Type="Choice" DisplayName="Department" Required="TRUE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE" ID="{c3d4e5f6-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f}" StaticName="Department" Name="Department" Description="Department this ticket belongs to."><Default></Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>IT</CHOICE><CHOICE>HR</CHOICE><CHOICE>Operations</CHOICE><CHOICE>Finance</CHOICE><CHOICE>Facilities</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

fields.Description: Category of the ticket, linked to the Categories list.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Lookup" DisplayName="Category" Required="FALSE" List="Categories" ShowField="Title" ID="{d4e5f6a7-8b9c-0d1e-2f3a-4b5c6d7e8f9a}" StaticName="Category" Name="Category" Description="Category of the ticket, linked to the Categories list." />

<Field Type="Choice" DisplayName="Priority" Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE" ID="{e5f6a7b8-9c0d-1e2f-3a4b-5c6d7e8f9a0b}" StaticName="Priority" Name="Priority" Description="Priority level of the ticket."><Default>Medium</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>Low</CHOICE><CHOICE>Medium</CHOICE><CHOICE>High</CHOICE><CHOICE>Critical</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="Choice" DisplayName="Status" Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE" ID="{f6a7b8c9-0d1e-2f3a-4b5c-6d7e8f9a0b1c}" StaticName="Status" Name="Status" Description="Current status of the ticket."><Default>New</Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>New</CHOICE><CHOICE>Assigned</CHOICE><CHOICE>In Progress</CHOICE><CHOICE>Pending Requester</CHOICE><CHOICE>Resolved</CHOICE><CHOICE>Closed</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

<Field Type="User" DisplayName="Requester" Required="FALSE" UserSelectionMode="PeopleOnly" UserSelectionScope="0" ID="{a7b8c9d0-1e2f-3a4b-5c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d}" StaticName="Requester" Name="Requester" Description="Person who submitted the ticket." />

fields.Description: Agent currently assigned to resolve this ticket.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="User" DisplayName="Assigned To" Required="FALSE" UserSelectionMode="PeopleOnly" UserSelectionScope="0" ID="{b8c9d0e1-2f3a-4b5c-6d7e-8f9a0b1c2d3e}" StaticName="AssignedTo" Name="AssignedTo" Description="Agent currently assigned to resolve this ticket." />

fields.Description: Target date/time by which this ticket must be resolved per SLA.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="DateTime" DisplayName="SLA Due Date" Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime" ID="{c9d0e1f2-3a4b-5c6d-7e8f-9a0b1c2d3e4f}" StaticName="SLADueDate" Name="SLADueDate" Description="Target date/time by which this ticket must be resolved per SLA." />

fields.Description: Notes describing how the issue was resolved.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Note" DisplayName="Resolution Notes" Required="FALSE" RichText="TRUE" RichTextMode="FullHtml" NumLines="6" AppendOnly="FALSE" ID="{d0e1f2a3-4b5c-6d7e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a}" StaticName="ResolutionNotes" Name="ResolutionNotes" Description="Notes describing how the issue was resolved." />

fields.Description: Channel through which the ticket was submitted.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Choice" DisplayName="Source" Required="FALSE" Format="Dropdown" FillInChoice="FALSE" ID="{e1f2a3b4-5c6d-7e8f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b}" StaticName="Source" Name="Source" Description="Channel through which the ticket was submitted."><Default></Default><CHOICES><CHOICE>Portal</CHOICE><CHOICE>Email</CHOICE><CHOICE>Teams</CHOICE><CHOICE>Phone</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

fields.Description: Date and time the ticket was resolved.
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="DateTime" DisplayName="Resolution Date" Required="FALSE" Format="DateTime" ID="{f2a3b4c5-6d7e-8f9a-0b1c-2d3e4f5a6b7c}" StaticName="ResolutionDate" Name="ResolutionDate" Description="Date and time the ticket was resolved." />

fields.Description: Current escalation tier (0 = not escalated, 1 = Tier 1 escalation, etc.).
fields.SchemaXml: <Field Type="Number" DisplayName="Escalation Level" Required="FALSE" Min="0" Max="5" Decimals="0" ID="{a3b4c5d6-7e8f-9a0b-1c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d}" StaticName="EscalationLevel" Name="EscalationLevel" Description="Current escalation tier (0 = not escalated, 1 = Tier 1 escalation, etc.)."><Default>0</Default></Field>
